researchQuestion: How do FCFS single-queue multi-server systems perform under configurable Poisson arrivals and exponential service times?
scope: Finite discrete-event simulation of one FCFS queue feeding 1-4 identical servers.
mechanisms: immediate assignment to any idle server
assumptions: Arrivals and service durations are independent
Servers are identical and continuously available
No abandonment, priorities, blocking, setup time, or finite capacity
All times are in arbitrary time units
limitations: This is a stochastic teaching model, not calibrated real-world evidence
Finite samples can be noisy and do not establish steady-state performance
Exponential distributions may not represent a particular operation
Results depend on the supplied seed and parameters

mean_wait.description: Mean time from arrival until service starts

max_wait.description: Maximum time from arrival until service starts

mean_sojourn.description: Mean time from arrival until service completion
